name: R3c · Area from simple shapes
premise: The area idea from rectangles and pentagons only: a rider area constructed from 6 primitives with its upright before in the lost colour, and pure before/after area with no figure.

items.title: Pentagon shrinks, plate
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 2/2/1/2/2/2 = 11/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 28.4%, lost 23.4%. Family 2. d/01 refined: filled orange before-pentagon, paper after-pentagon scaled 0.74 about its lower-left vertex; fill up from 21%. Plainest 'smaller' read on the shelf, no near-twin. Could be any app: no rider or bike read, needs the name beside it. Edges are freeform, not 0/45/90.

items.title: Pentagon shrinks, house
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 2/2/1/1/2/2 = 10/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 28.4%, lost 23.4%. Family 2. Same in acid/amber on black. Acid on black brushes the Apple Measure palette; acid and amber close in greyscale but still split.

items.title: Rectangle shrinks to corner
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 2/2/1/1/2/1 = 9/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 25.0%, lost 36.0%. Family 2, rectangles only. Strongest smaller read, but generic app geometry: reads as resize/crop/window. Gate pass on paper only.

items.title: Constructed rider, plate
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 1/1/1/2/2/1 = 8/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 28.3%, lost 5.6%. Family 1, 6 primitives: head rect, torso pentagon (flat shoulders, 45 deg V hidden by the bar), two 45 deg arm rects landing inside the bar, bar, wheel stub. Before kit = head + torso 112 u higher. Rider-at-the-bar reads at 64; at 40 it turns pylon/pagoda. The orange cap reads as a hat before it reads as lost area.

items.title: Constructed rider, quiet lost
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 1/1/1/2/2/1 = 8/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 28.3%, lost 5.6%. Family 1 with lost #5C86BC. Cap reads less like a hat, but the lost signal nearly disappears at 40.

items.title: Pentagon helmet rider
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 1/1/1/2/2/1 = 8/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 27.1%, lost 6.7%. Family 1 with a pentagon helmet (flat top, chin point). Uses the pentagon where the brief asked; at 64 the chin point reads as a beak or pencil tip.

items.title: Constructed rider, full length
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 1/1/1/2/2/1 = 8/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 21.5%, lost 4.1%. Family 1 at 0.86 scale with headroom. Below fill target; more air, less presence than the bust.

items.title: Head and shoulders blocks
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 1/2/1/1/2/1 = 8/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 33.8%, lost 17.5%. Two rects kept inside two rects lost: the R3a dome idea in two blocks. Only candidate inside the 32-40% kept target, but it reads as a bottle or jar.

items.title: Constructed rider, house
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 1/1/1/1/2/1 = 7/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 28.3%, lost 5.6%. Family 1 in acid/amber. On black it reads as a Christmas tree or pylon.

items.title: Constructed rider, house 333
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 1/0/1/1/2/1 = 7/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 28.3%, lost 5.6%. Family 1 with #333 lost: lost cap invisible at 64, head reads as a top hat.

items.title: T-stack, no arms
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 1/1/1/1/2/1 = 7/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 25.7%, lost 6.3%. 4 rects: head, torso, bar, wheel. Reads as a lamp or hydrant.

items.title: Shield pentagon shrinks
items.note: S1 S2 S3 S4 S6 S7 0/2/1/1/2/1 = 7/12, S5 0 (no tolerance device); kept 22.7%, lost 25.4%. Apex-down pentagon pair. Reads as a badge or security app.
